events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Toland
events.description: 2 deaths. Cumberland County. A severe thunderstorm, producing wind gusts estimated at 60 mph, knocked down multiple trees and large branches in Mountain Creek Campground. One of the large trees fell down on a tent with three occupants, this tree killed two of the occupants (a 45-year-old woman and her 11-year-old son) and injured the other occupant.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Blooming Grove
events.description: 1 death. York County. A severe thunderstorm, producing wind gusts estimated near 60 mph, stranded a boater on Lake Marburg in Codorus State Park. These boaters were on the lake ahead of and during the severe thunderstorm. After an original water rescue, saving two stranded boaters, another set of stranded boaters was found on Lake Marburg. One individual was rescued with the other located two days later after perishing in the lake.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Shawmont
events.description: 2 deaths. Philadelphia County. A large tree feel on a moving vehicle.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Christiana
events.description: 1 death. Lancaster County. A man was killed in Sadsbury Township when a severe thunderstorm producing wind gusts estimated at 60 mph knocked a large tree limb down, which struck him as he was operating a tractor.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Highcliff
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Allegheny County. At approximately 5:08 PM based off of radar coverage, a line of storms crossing the Pittsburgh area with very strong, damaging wind gusts caused a tree to fall and kill a man as he was walking back to his house in Ross Township.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near East Monongahela
events.description: 1 death. Greene County. As severe thunderstorms crossed across Greene County, PA, a large tree fell and struck a car killing the male in the passenger side as they were travelling along Jefferson Road in Franklin Township.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near State College
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Centre County. A line of severe thunderstorms producing wind gusts estimated at 70 mph knocked down power lines near the 1500 block of University Drive in State College. A man was killed as he was electrocuted while trying to put out a mulch fire that started as a result of the downed power lines.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Pine Grove Mills
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Centre County. A line of severe thunderstorms producing wind gusts estimated at 70 mph knocked down multiple trees and power lines near Pine Grove Mills. A motorist exited his vehicle after stopping due to a fallen tree, began walking towards the tree, and was electrocuted by a downed power line.

events.title: Flood near Hinkletown
events.description: 1 death. Lancaster County. Heavy rainfall led to flooding along Cabin Drive near Ephrata during the early morning hours of December 18, 2023. A direct fatality was reported when a 73-year old male drove into the flood waters and drowned during the pre-dawn hours.

events.title: Flash Flood near Chinchilla
events.description: 2 deaths. Lackawanna County. A man and woman succumbed to flash flooding as they attempted to evacuate their vehicle while stuck in the railroad overpass crossing Shady Lane. Flood waters rapidly filled their vehicle and the woman was swept downstream. The man was also swept away and sustained grave injuries after being slammed into a sign post and guardrail. He died a few days later. Severe flooding also stranded several other vehicles in this immediate area.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Montrose
events.description: 1 death. Susquehanna County. Strong thunderstorm winds knocked down a tree which fell on a 31 year old man. Unfortunately the man passed away from his injuries.

events.title: Flash Flood near Buckmanville
events.description: 7 deaths. Bucks County. Catastrophic flash flooding occurred in Upper Makefield Township, resulting in the loss of seven lives. A reliable rain gauge located within the township indicated that 4.64 inches of rain fell during the event which lasted less than 2 hours. Widespread roadway flooding occurred with many roads becoming impassable. Numerous water rescues took place in the township. The worst of the flooding occurred along Hough's Creek. The creek rose rapidly and the rushing water carried away many vehicles, most along Taylorsville Road which parallels the Delaware Canal. Eleven vehicles were reported to have…

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near New Providence
events.description: 1 death. Lancaster County. A severe thunderstorm producing winds estimated near 60 mph knocked down a large branch along the 100 block of Sawmill Road in Providence Township, with one fatality reported.

events.title: Lightning near Parkesburg
events.description: 1 death. Chester County. Pennsylvania State police reported that lightning struck a tree, causing a large branch to fall on a vehicle on Limestone Road just north of Highland Road in Highland Township, PA. Time estimated via radar.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Franklin
events.description: 1 death. Venango County. A large tree fell on to two trailers in the Idlewood Trailer Park on Maplewood Drive. A 28-year old woman was killed via blunt force trauma.

events.title: Flash Flood near King Of Prussia
events.description: 2 deaths. Montgomery County. Widespread flash flooding occurred in Montgomery County with many road closures and vehicles stranded. Numerous water rescues took place. There were two flood related fatalities, one in Skippack and one in Bridgeport. Many buildings and homes were flooded. Most waterways in the county overflowed their banks, including the Schuylkill River, Perkiomen Creek and Wissahickon Creek.

events.title: Flash Flood near Aquetong
events.description: 1 death. Bucks County. Widespread flash flooding occurred in upper Bucks County with many road closures and vehicles stranded. There were numerous water rescues. One flood related fatality was reported in Milford Township. Most waterways in the county overflowed, including the Delaware River (with a highly unusual quick response to the runoff), Neshaminy Creek, Tohickon Creek and the East Branch of the Perkiomen Creek. Many buildings and homes were flooded.

events.title: Flash Flood near Nottingham
events.description: 1 death. Chester County. Widespread flash flooding occurred in Chester County with many road closures and vehicles stranded. There was a flood related fatality in Downingtown. Numerous waterways in the county flooded, including the Schuylkill River, the West Branch of the Brandywine Creek, the East Branch of the Brandywine Creek, White Clay Creek, Red Clay Creek, French Creek and Valley Creek. There were many reports of water entering buildings and homes.

events.title: Tornado near Flourtown
events.description: 1 death. Montgomery County. A semi-discrete supercell thunderstorm began to exhibit rotation |over Delaware County, PA around 5:15 PM on September 1. The |rotation continued north-northeast into Montgomery County, and |eventually strengthened enough to produce a tornado. events.title: Lightning near Duryea
events.description: 1 death. Luzerne County. A 71 year old man was struck and killed by lightning while golfing.

events.title: Flood near Dickeys Mtn
events.description: 1 death. Fulton County. Heavy rain resulted in flooding on Licking Creek. A man crossing a flooded road, was swept away, and was later found deceased.

events.title: Flash Flood near Coopersburg
events.description: 1 death. Lehigh County. A car driven by a 44-year-old woman was swept away by flood waters along the 6300 block of North Main Street in Upper Saucon Township near a bridge that passes over Laurel Run. The victim was pronounced dead later in the day after the waters receded.

events.title: Flash Flood near Worcester
events.description: 1 death. Montgomery County. A 5-year-old girl with autism was swept away by flood waters running through a tributary of Towamencin Creek after wandering away from her nearby family home. Rescuers found the victim's body adjacent to the creek in Fischer's Park after a 22-hour search.

events.title: Lightning near Bailey Corners
events.description: 2 deaths. Bradford County. Lightning from a nearby thunderstorm struck four individuals under a tree stand in the area of 447 Tube Drive in Granville Township. Two of these people were killed and the other two were injured. They were holding a metal latter at the time they were struck.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Philmont Country Clu
events.description: 1 death. Montgomery County. A tree crased through the roof of a building at the Philmont Country Club in Lower Moreland Township killing one employee.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near West Manayunk
events.description: 1 death. Montgomery County. A tree fell on the roof of a car killing one person near the intersection of Belmont Avenue and Rock Hill Road. Time estimated from radar.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Wynnewood
events.description: 1 death. Montgomery County. A tree fell on the roof of a car killing one person in Lower Merion along Medford Road.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Crum Creek Manor
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Delaware County. A tree fell on a power line that fell on a house near Wallingford, which then started a house fire, killing one individual. Time estimated from radar.

events.title: Flash Flood near Rillton
events.description: 1 death. Westmoreland County. One man died when he was swept into a storm drain. The incident happened in Sewickley Township near Clay Pike. His wife told police that her husband had just finished clearing the drain of leaves and sticks when he got pulled down.

events.title: Flash Flood near Pine Forge
events.description: 2 deaths. Berks County. A pregnant woman and her son were trapped in a car that flipped over after being swept against a guardrail on Grist Mill Road near Locust Road along the Ironstone Creek. The two were trapped inside the vehicle, where they both perished. The rescue crew could not reach them until the water receded about 5 hours later.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Keating
events.description: 1 death. Clinton County. A severe thunderstorm producing winds estimated near 60 mph knocked down trees near Keating. One of the trees fell onto two kayakers who has pulled ashore when the storm approached. The kayakers were transported to a nearby hospital, and one passed away.

events.title: Lightning near Weltytown
events.description: 2 deaths. Westmoreland County. Two teenagers were struck by lightning while fishing and killed.

events.title: Flash Flood near Levittown
events.description: 1 death. Bucks County. The local fire department pulled a male teenager out of the flood swollen Mill Creek in Middletown Township. The individual was kayaking with another male teenage when he fell out of the kayak. The victim was pulled from the creek but later died at Children's Hospital in Philadelphia. A law enforcement official indicated that the creek's high and fast moving water likely contributed to the victims death.

events.title: Flood near Deodate
events.description: 1 death. Dauphin County. At 9pm, A 19 year old female attempted to swim across Conewago Creek with her 22 year old relative. She was unable to cross the creek due to the fast current and was swept away. She was found downstream several days later deceased.

events.title: Flood near Heidlersburg
events.description: 1 death. Adams County. On Wednesday, July 25th, An 18 year old boy was found deceased along Conewago Creek by Stone Jug Road and Benders Church Road in Butler Township. His family reported him missing on July 23rd, and it is believed he was last seen on Sunday evening.

events.title: Flash Flood near Eaglehurst
events.description: 2 deaths. Erie County. Warm humid air over the region supported strong thunderstorms and torrential rainfall. A rain gauge network in Mill Creek Township measured an instantaneous rainfall rate of over 7 inches per hour around 630 pm. The storms produced a measured 3.85 inches of rainfall in the Erie/Mill Creek area. The intensity of the rainfall ultimately overwhelmed storm drainage systems causing significant overland flooding. In Mill Creek some roads were reported to have as much as five feet of water with numerous water rescues conducted. Some structures sustained damage and the Mill Creek Fire Department had…

events.title: Flash Flood near Shelocta
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Indiana County. Emergency management reported that a man drowned as he attempting to clean debris from an overflow pipe in a pond near his home on Sportsman Club Road when the kayak he was in flipped and his legs were pulled into the pipe. Water then continued to rise, submerging the individual.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Cedar Spgs
events.description: 1 death. Clinton County. A severe thunderstorm producing straight line winds estimated at 95 to 100 mph knocked down trees onto a home in Lamar Township, causing one fatality.

events.title: Lightning near Stemlersville
events.description: 1 death. Carbon County. Lightning struck in the Beltzville Lake. The lightning strike spread through the water and injured several people and killing a man. Details still unknown on number of injuries etc.

events.title: Flash Flood near Bustleton
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Philadelphia County. The Pennypack gauge rose just above flood stage to 7.42 feet at 815Z. It was below flood stage by 830Z. A man jumped into the high waters during the overnight hours to rescue a dog. The man was swept away by the current and found dead at 9:30 am according to Law Enforcement and Media reports.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Vandergriff Corners
events.description: 1 death. Warren County. Thunderstorms producing winds estimated around 90 mph knocked down trees in a campground, killing one person and injuring 4 others in the Minister Creek recreation area.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Jacksville
events.description: 1 death. Butler County. A large tree branch over 2 feet in diameter fell into a mobile home, killing a 31 year old male inside.

events.title: Lightning near Oakryn
events.description: 1 death. Lancaster County. Two boys were struck by lightning while running across a field after getting out of the Little Conowingo Creek in Fulton Township near Peach Bottom in Lancaster County. Authorities said the boys were swimming with friends near Nottingham and Soapstone Roads when a thunderstorm moved through the area. One boy was killed while the other sustained minor injuries.

events.title: Flash Flood near Layton
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Fayette County. Flash flooding washed out a bridge over a culvert on Falbo Road in Perry Township. A driver was killed when he drove into the culvert after the bridge had been washed out.
